kultivator.sekte.misi.berangkat: Team %3$s (%4$s disciples) leaves for %1$s, tier %2$s, with a %5$s stance. They will be back in %6$s days.
kultivator.sekte.misi.buka.damai: On the Sect Master's order, %1$s led %3$s disciples towards %2$s with one charge: seek the peaceful way, never draw first.
kultivator.sekte.misi.buka.licik: %1$s took %3$s disciples to %2$s dressed as common traders. The Sect Master's word: eyes and ears are sharper than swords.
kultivator.sekte.misi.buka.tegas: %1$s and %3$s disciples set out for %2$s with swords on their backs. The Sect Master's order was plain: show the sect's strength if need be.
kultivator.sekte.misi.calon: %s youths came home with the team and wait for the next Recruitment Day.

kultivator.sekte.misi.sikap.licik.desc: Eyes and ears first: +8 points at cunning stages, -5 at diplomacy stages.
kultivator.sekte.misi.sikap.tegas.desc: Show strength: +8 points at combat stages, -5 at cunning stages.
kultivator.sekte.misi.status.petunjuk: Open the Misi tablet of the Sect Hall (sections Story Missions / Mission News), or the Story Missions card in the Scroll.
kultivator.sekte.misi.sumber: Source: I Shall Seal the Heavens ch. 19 (outer disciples come back with two or three talented youths); the expeditions into the Magical Beast Mountain Range in Battle Through the Heavens.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.buru.desc: A demonic beast preys on travellers on the mountain road. Its core is precious, its fangs are deadly.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.buru.s1.gagal: The team circled %3$s for two days; the trail of %4$s vanished in a stream.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.buru.s1.ok: %1$s found the lair of %4$s at %3$s by the smell of blood and the clawed tree trunks.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.buru.s2.gagal: Yet %4$s was faster than anyone thought. Its charge broke the formation and the team fell back into the rocks.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.buru.s2.ok: The first fight broke out at a cliff edge. %1$s's three-point formation drove %4$s back with a wounded shoulder.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.buru.s3.gagal: The beast fled roaring into the deep mountains. The team came home with nothing but its claw marks.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.buru.s3.ok: As the moon rose, %2$s struck true at its vital point. The beast fell, its core still warm and glowing.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.cari.desc: A disciple left the sect to wander. The last word says it was seen on far roads. Perhaps its heart can still be called home.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.cari.s1.gagal: The trail of %5$s at %3$s had gone cold; people only remembered a quiet traveller.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.cari.s1.ok: A tea seller at %3$s recognised the description of %5$s and pointed out the road it took.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.cari.s2.gagal: %5$s saw the sect robes from afar and vanished into the market crowd before %1$s could call out.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.cari.s2.ok: %1$s found %5$s sitting alone under an old tree. They talked until the campfire died.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.cari.s3.gagal: "Tell the Master I am not ready," said %5$s. The team came home with nothing but news.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.cari.s3.ok: %2$s delivered the Sect Master's message word for word. %5$s was silent for a long time, then tightened the cord of its bundle.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.desa.desc: A village headman comes to the sect gate begging for help. The people protected today are the disciples of tomorrow.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.desa.s1.gagal: The team got lost at %3$s and only reached %5$s the next noon; the villagers had half given up.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.desa.s1.ok: %1$s reached %5$s before dusk and heard the villagers out: livestock gone, and children afraid to leave their homes.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.desa.s2.gagal: This time %4$s came in too great a number. The team saved the houses, but part of the village granary burned.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.desa.s2.ok: That night %4$s came again. This time %2$s was waiting in the granary, and it never came back.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.desa.s3.gagal: The people of %5$s gave thin thanks. The headman quietly asked whether the sect could still protect them.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.desa.s3.ok: The people of %5$s walked the team to the edge of the village. Some of the youths stared at the sect robes with shining eyes.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.herba.desc: Rumour says a thousand-year herb has bloomed in a remote place. What guards it is not human.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.herba.s1.gagal: The herb map was wrong. The team combed %3$s all day for nothing.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.herba.s1.ok: %1$s followed a faint medicinal scent all the way to %3$s, where the morning dew is tinged green.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.herba.s2.gagal: Someone had picked the herb already; only a young shoot and strange footprints were left.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.herba.s2.ok: %2$s found the herb in a cleft of the cliff: gold-veined leaves, roots clasping a spirit stone.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.herba.s3.gagal: The herb's guardian, %4$s, went wild. The team withdrew empty-handed with only a few fallen leaves.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.herba.s3.ok: The herb's guardian, %4$s, woke and attacked. The team held it long enough for %1$s to pull the herb out roots and all.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.kabar.desc: A pedlar brings word of a strange light at night. Perhaps a treasure, perhaps only a story.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.kabar.s1.gagal: At %3$s everyone told the rumour differently. The team wasted its time chasing shadows.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.kabar.s1.ok: The folk of %3$s confirmed it: three nights running, a silvery light rose behind the hill.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.kabar.s2.gagal: The map %2$s bought was a fake; its seller was long gone.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.kabar.s2.ok: %2$s posed as a hunter and got a rough map from a drunk in the tavern.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.kabar.s3.gagal: The hill was empty. Whatever once shone there was gone.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.kabar.s3.ok: %1$s found the source of the light and wrote down where it lay before coming home.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.kawal.desc: A merchant caravan asks for guards through a mountain pass full of bandits. The pay is spirit stones and goods.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.kawal.s1.gagal: At %3$s the mist came down too fast; two carts slid into a ditch and the team lost half a day hauling them out.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.kawal.s1.ok: At %3$s, %1$s read the wheel ruts and chose the safe way round. The caravan did not lose a single sack.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.kawal.s2.gagal: At dawn %4$s attacked. The team held, but several crates of goods were carried off.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.kawal.s2.ok: On the third night %4$s fell on the camp. %2$s struck first, and the attackers fled, leaving their weapons behind.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.kawal.s3.gagal: The caravan master counted his losses and cut the pay. %1$s swallowed the anger and took what was given.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.kawal.s3.ok: At the city gate the caravan master bowed deeply to %1$s and added to the pay with his own hands.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.lelang.desc: Disciples are sent to the yearly auction of a distant city. The team carries the hall pool's contribution points (not spirit stones); half comes back if they return empty-handed. The Auction House of the towns in the world is still yours to visit.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.lelang.s1.gagal: The auction house wardens at %3$s put the team in the farthest corner, far from the stage.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.lelang.s1.ok: %1$s won a seat on the upper floor of the auction house at %3$s with a letter of introduction and good manners.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.lelang.s2.gagal: A great clan's young master kept raising the bid only to shame our sect. The price soared beyond reason.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.lelang.s2.ok: %2$s watched who bid nervously and waited for the right moment to raise.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.lelang.s3.gagal: The team left the auction house with purses still heavy and hearts let down.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.lelang.s3.ok: The hammer fell. The prize went to %1$s, and the auctioneer wrapped it himself.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.perbatasan.desc: Intruders have been seen at the edge of the sect's land. A border nobody guards will be trampled.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.perbatasan.s1.ga: The scouts of %4$s slipped away from %3$s with news of our guards' strength.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.perbatasan.s1.ok: On the first day at %3$s the team drove off the scouts of %4$s before they could set their marks.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.perbatasan.s2.ga: The team lost the trail in the border forest; nobody slept well that night.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.perbatasan.s2.ok: %2$s combed the border forest and found the enemy's hidden camp.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.perbatasan.s3.ga: A counterattack by %4$s pushed the team back inside our own land. The border is still unsteady.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.perbatasan.s3.ok: %1$s's dawn attack broke the camp. The sect's boundary stones stand straight again.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.pusaka.desc: A treasure's light has risen from the earth. Every sect nearby has sent its people; the slow will see only dust.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.pusaka.s1.gagal: The team's ruse was found out. %4$s now watched their every move at %3$s.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.pusaka.s1.ok: %1$s spread a false word about where the treasure lay; half the hunters at %3$s rushed the wrong way.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.pusaka.s2.gagal: Suddenly %4$s struck from two sides. The team was scattered and lost the best ground.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.pusaka.s2.ok: At the foot of the pillar of light the team faced %4$s. %2$s held off three at once while the others pushed forward.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.pusaka.s3.gagal: In the end it was %4$s who carried the treasure off. The team picked up only shards of still-warm stone.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.pusaka.s3.ok: As the light faded, %1$s's hand was the first to touch the treasure. The team withdrew in tight formation and could not be followed.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.reruntuhan.desc: A landslide has opened the door of an ancient cave abode. Its formations still live, and others want it too.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.reruntuhan.s1.ga: The first tunnel at %3$s caved in behind the team. They had to dig another way all night.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.reruntuhan.s1.ok: %1$s found a stone door at %3$s, half buried in moss, its sealing script still faintly gleaming.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.reruntuhan.s2.ga: A formation trap flared; poison smoke drove the team out of the first chamber.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.reruntuhan.s2.ok: %2$s read the guardian formation's pattern and found its gap. One by one the old seals opened without springing a trap.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.reruntuhan.s3.ga: The deepest chamber had already been taken by %4$s. The team only managed to pick up what was left in the tunnels.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.reruntuhan.s3.ok: In the deepest chamber %4$s was already waiting. %1$s led the counterattack and the team came out with the stone chest's contents.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.samar.desc: A hostile sect is preparing something. The team disguises itself as their outer disciples to find out what.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.samar.s1.gagal: A guard of %4$s grew suspicious of %2$s's accent. The team had to scatter before they got in.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.samar.s1.ok: %1$s and the team slipped into the outer disciples of %4$s in borrowed robes and false names.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.samar.s2.gagal: The team caught only scraps of the plan; the elders of %4$s kept their doors too tightly shut.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.samar.s2.ok: From behind a scripture shelf %2$s overheard the elders of %4$s and copied the plan of their storehouse.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.samar.s3.gagal: The disguise was uncovered. The team broke out under a hail of attacks from %4$s, and that sect now knows who sent them.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.samar.s3.ok: The disguise was uncovered on the last day, but %1$s had already led the team out by the water channel before the alarm sounded.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.utusan.desc: The Sect Master entrusts a sealed letter for another sect. The right words are worth more than a thousand spirit stones.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.utusan.s1.gagal: Floods at %3$s cut the road to %5$s. The team arrived three days late, and the gatekeepers frowned.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.utusan.s1.ok: The road to the gate of %5$s through %3$s went smoothly; %1$s arrived on the very day promised.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.utusan.s2.gagal: An elder of %5$s mocked our sect; %2$s answered too sharply and the hall went cold.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.utusan.s2.ok: In the guest hall %1$s presented the Sect Master's letter with both hands and answered every elder's question without faltering.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.utusan.s3.gagal: The team was sent home without a banquet. The reply of %5$s was short and cold.
kultivator.sekte.misi.t.utusan.s3.ok: At the farewell banquet the master of %5$s poured wine for %1$s with his own hand and sent warm greetings.
kultivator.sekte.misi.tarik.tidak: That team can no longer be called home.
kultivator.sekte.misi.tarik.tinggal: The %1$s team is called home without its wounded. %2$s disciples are left in the field and must come home alone.
kultivator.sekte.misi.tempat.14: the old temple of the Cracked Bell
kultivator.sekte.misi.tempat.7: the ruins of the Cloud Palace
kultivator.sekte.misi.temu.gagal: %1$s did not come back. Another time perhaps, said %2$s.
kultivator.sekte.misi.temu.ok: %1$s walked through the gate with the team. It came home.
kultivator.sekte.misi.tutup.0: The team came home with bowed heads. %1$s knelt before the stele: "This disciple failed, Master. Punish me."
kultivator.sekte.misi.tutup.1: The team came home with part of what it went for. %1$s said quietly, "Half was won, and the other half was a lesson."
kultivator.sekte.misi.tutup.2: The team came home safe with heads held high. %1$s handed over this scroll with both hands.
kultivator.sekte.misi.tutup.3: The sect's name was heard all along the road home; traders and travellers spoke of %1$s and companions. This homecoming will be told for a long time.
kultivator.sekte.misi.ui.jenjang_kurang: The team's ranks are too low for this tier.
kultivator.sekte.misi.ui.kirim.tip: The team leaves as data (no load on the world) and comes home through the gate with a report.

kultivator.sekte.misi.ui.tarik.tip: The whole team comes home now; the mission ends with the stages done so far.
kultivator.sekte.misi.ui.tarik.tip_luka: The whole team comes home carrying the wounded: it takes a quarter day.
kultivator.sekte.misi.ui.tinggal.tip: The healthy come home at once; the wounded are left to come home alone at the mission's end. They will remember it (Sacrificed).
kultivator.sekte.misi.ui.tip_sikap: Pick a stance under the board: a fitting stance raises its stages' chance.
